declarations: Additional declared references, not recovered LETTER P5 baseline recipes or expected published values.
Native ordered-pair overwrites are preserved, not silently replaced with undirected sums.
Full-catalog zero rows repair a native dense-ID assumption; cold rows can also change warm-item spectral partitions.
Native model, fixed-width CID recursion, CID serialization, title/category mapping functions, ten prompt texts, dataset sampling and collator are reused from checked private source.
The unused missing change_base import is removed from the verified data module AST; unsupported item-resolution code is never invoked.
No P5 benchmark interactions, fabricated timestamps or substituted category files are used.
Instruments category strings are an explicitly adapted released taxonomy, not a claimed recovery of original Amazon metadata.
Complete title lengths and canonicalization/collision diagnostics replace native hidden 512/10-token truncation; constrained TID is not an unconstrained published-score replay.
EOS/pad whole-word zeroing is an explicit batch-invariance correction.
Native encoder precomputation preserves shijie in generation; past_key_values is mapped to the native legacy past argument without modifying Transformers.
Single-GPU accumulation matches the logged two-GPU effective batch128, not its exact distributed/dropout trajectory. Tail examples are weighted by actual count.
Seed42, sorted added vocabulary, saved serial sampling, float64 sparse root graph and the independently pinned compatible runtime are declared adaptations.
No test scores are consulted for indexing, recipe choices or checkpoint selection.
